envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: the omp badge rendered beneath the status line because 'status' is not in omp's default segment layout

payload.gloss: the running persona's name and mark emoji shown in the harness status line so the operator sees which persona a session runs; projected from the agent cell into that persona's own launch scope, so placement names the persona and nothing asks at runtime; shown only in the top-level interactive session, never a subagent's; its own module, apart from guardrails and session hooks; carries no hue where the harness strips color (omp strips it from extension status text) On Claude Code the status line is one host-owned command with no segments: install sets a badge status line only where the host has none, and otherwise offers to wrap the host's command, never replacing it. On Claude Code, placement still decides which personas have a badge, and the harness's own status-line input names the persona running (agent.name); the status line asks nothing else. On omp an extension's status appears inside the status line only where the host's layout includes omp's 'status' segment (absent from omp's default layout; otherwise it renders beneath the status line), so install adds 'status' to the host's statusLine.leftSegments, writing omp's default left list plus 'status' when the host has none, appending it to the host's own list otherwise, never reordering or removing a segment, and reporting what it changed.
